RagShortTexts: The Balliol dynasty held immense estates across Durham and Galloway, founding Balliol.

Variants.Content: Ruling Barnard Castle in Durham and extensive lordships in Galloway, John de Balliol amassed immense Anglo-Scottish wealth alongside Lady Dervorguilla. Founders of Oxford's Balliol College, their lineage held direct blood claims to the Scottish throne.
Supported by the powerful Comyns, the Balliols commanded a formidable network of castles capable of challenging the Bruces.
